intro.h2: Real projects, clean work and clear answers
paragraphs: Martins Home Maintenance & Repair LLC offers handyman and remodeling work in Montgomery, NY, led by Elias, and the jobs clients describe go well past small fixes. He converted half of one family's garage into a laundry room, framing a raised floor over the concrete and finishing it with plank flooring and laundry hookups. For another client he ran hot and cold water lines, a drainage line and a steel gas line.

What clients mention most is how he works. He talks you through what needs to be done, stays patient with questions and does not leave a mess. Clean work and communication are the two topics Google reviewers bring up most.

services.h2: What Elias can do for your home

items.name: Garage and room conversions
items.blurb: Half of a garage can become a laundry room. For one family, Elias framed a raised wood floor over the garage slab, then finished the room with wood-look plank flooring, painted walls, a recessed washer box and a dryer vent. The client says he did a wonderful job.

image.alt: New laundry room with gray wood-look plank floor, white walls, a recessed washer valve box and a dryer vent

items.name: Plumbing and gas lines
items.blurb: Elias runs new hot and cold water lines, installs drainage lines and runs steel pipe for gas. One client who had all three done says everything was professionally done, with very clean work and great communication, and recommends him for any type of house work.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a tidy utility room in an older American raised ranch home: neatly run copper hot and cold water lines with shutoff valves, a white PVC drain line and a black steel gas pipe with a yellow-handled shutoff, all clamped straight along a painted wall above a sealed concrete floor, in slate gray-blue, warm oak, warm beige and espresso brown, soft natural light from a small window, clean and finished, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:3
image.alt: Neatly run copper water lines and a black steel gas pipe along a finished utility room wall

items.name: Built-ins and interior walls
items.blurb: A plain wall between two arched doorways became a media wall. Elias framed it out, hung and finished the drywall, built two recessed shelf niches lined in dark wood, and trimmed it with baseboard and crown so the TV could hang above. Our gallery shows each stage.

image.alt: Media wall in progress with new drywall, taped seams and two framed shelf niches between arched doorways

items.name: Bathroom upgrades
items.blurb: Small bathroom upgrades are part of the work too. In one job shared on our Facebook page, a customer wanted to swap out an old three-handle fixture for something newer. Call to describe the faucet, valve or other bathroom update you have in mind.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of an updated tub and shower wall in an older American home bathroom: classic white subway tile, a new single-handle shower valve trim and matching shower head and tub spout in brushed nickel, a white tub and a light gray shower curtain pulled aside, in slate gray-blue, warm oak, warm beige and espresso brown, soft natural daylight, clean and finished, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:3
image.alt: Updated tub and shower wall with a single-handle valve trim and a new shower head

about.h2: About Elias and Martins Home Maintenance & Repair
about.text: Martins Home Maintenance & Repair LLC is run by Elias, who answers his Google reviews himself and thanks clients for trusting him with their projects. His work shows up across the house and garage: framing, drywall, built-in shelving, flooring, water, drain and gas lines, and bathroom fixture upgrades. Clients call him professional and very knowledgeable, and say he explains what needs to be done before starting. One client recommends him to anyone who needs any type of house work, and another would definitely use him again.

service_area.h2: Handyman and remodeling in Montgomery, NY
service_area.text: Martins Home Maintenance & Repair serves Montgomery, NY. Elias works on site, in your house or garage, and brings the job from rough framing to finished trim. If you live outside Montgomery and want to know whether your home is in range, call (845) 381-2746 during business hours or email martinsrepairs@outlook.com with your town and a short description of the job, whether it is a room conversion, a new gas or water line, a built-in wall or a bathroom fixture.

items.q: Can you turn part of my garage into a room?
items.a: Yes. Elias converted half of one family's garage into a laundry room, framing a raised floor over the slab and finishing it with plank flooring, painted walls, a washer box and a dryer vent. The client says he was professional, communicated well and did not leave a mess.

items.q: Do you run gas and water lines?
items.a: Yes. For one client Elias ran hot and cold water lines, installed a drainage line and ran a steel pipe line for gas. The client says everything was professionally done, with very clean work and great communication. Call to describe the lines you need.

We are open Monday through Thursday from 7 AM to 4 PM, Friday from 8 AM to 4 PM and Saturday from 8 AM to noon, with Sundays closed. Call (845) 381-2746 during those hours or email martinsrepairs@outlook.com, and include a phone number so Elias can call you back.

items.q: Will you explain the work before you start?
items.a: Yes. A client says Elias was able to talk them through what needed to be done and was extremely knowledgeable and patient with them. Ask as many questions as you like when he looks at the job, so you know what is involved before work begins.

items.q: How do I start a project?
items.a: Call (845) 381-2746 or email martinsrepairs@outlook.com with a short description of the project and a few photos of the space. Elias can then talk through what the job involves and arrange a time to see it in person before giving you a price.

final_cta.h2: Have a space that could work harder?
final_cta.text: Call Elias and talk through the room, line or wall you have in mind.
